title: Guidance as Variance Matching
abstract: arXiv:2611.34801v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Guidance repels the prediction of a diffusion model away from a weaker reference prediction. It substantially improves sample quality, but its mechanism remains poorly understood. We first find that, at the scales used in practice, guidance does not improve the prediction of the posterior mean (the model's training target); it makes the prediction worse, while samples improve. Second, posterior-mean predictions have less variance than the data, and we find that guidance restores it. We introduce variance-matched guidance: a closed-form rule that picks the guidance scale by matching the variance of the guided predictions to that of the data. Without tuning, it recovers the hand-picked scales of eleven widely used models across image, video, audio, motion, and world generation; to our knowledge, no previous explanation of guidance predicts them. Applied per noise level, it yields a schedule without tuned hyperparameters that users prefer

translated_abstract: 引导机制将扩散模型的预测推离一个较弱的参考预测。它显著提升了样本质量，但其内在机制至今仍缺乏深入理解。我们首先发现，在实际使用的引导尺度下，引导并不能改善对后验均值（即模型的训练目标）的预测；它反而使预测变差，但生成的样本却变得更好。其次，后验均值预测的方差低于数据本身的方差，而我们发现引导恰好能恢复这一方差。基于此，我们提出了方差匹配引导：一种闭式规则，通过将引导后预测的方差与数据的方差进行匹配来自动选择引导尺度。无需任何调参，该规则便能复现十一个广泛使用的模型在图像、视频、音频、动作和世界生成等任务中人工挑选的引导尺度；据我们所知，此前没有任何关于引导的解释能够预测出这些尺度。当按噪声水平逐级应用时，它还能产生一个无需调节超参数、且更受用户偏好的引导尺度调度方案。
tldr: 论文揭示扩散模型中的引导并非改善后验均值预测，而是恢复了被低估的方差，并提出无需调参的方差匹配引导闭式规则，可准确复现十一个主流模型的手工引导尺度。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that guidance in diffusion models does not improve posterior-mean predictions but instead restores underestimated variance, and proposes a tuning-free closed-form variance-matched guidance rule that accurately recovers the hand-picked guidance scales of eleven widely used models.
